decisions.reason: Although recent website visibility is weak, this adjustable cardboard quarter-pallet display remains close to the firm's core offer, so past development and public launch commitments still bias management toward continuation rather than withdrawal.

As a cardboard shelf display closely aligned with the established business, it still benefits from sunk launch effort and an earlier public commitment, making management more likely to retain it unless line simplification becomes necessary.
This standard cardboard quarter-pallet display sits most squarely in the firm's core direction, so escalation of commitment and low incremental burden strongly favor keeping it on the market.

Its narrower media focus makes withdrawal more plausible than for the other cardboard variants, but because it still builds directly on the firm's core quarter-pallet capability, management would likely persist for now.
